question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

The hunter felt no __compunction__ after killing the tiger.
solution:
The correct answer is "**remorse**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Compunction" means a feeling of guilt or moral scruple that prevents or follows the doing of something bad**.(मलाल)

 
 
• ​Example: But I can, without compunction, recommend the film purely on its own merits.
 
 
 
• **"Remorse" means ****a feeling of deep regret or guilt for a wrong committed.** (पछतावा)
 
 
• ​Example: She showed no remorse for what she had done
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, remorse is the most appropriate synonym for it.
 
• The sentence means that the hunter did not feel guilty or regretful after killing the tiger. 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (compulsion)** means a strong urge to do something.(बाध्यता)
 
• **Option 2 (pressure)** means the use of persuasion or force to make someone do something.(दबाव)
 
• **Option 3 (pleasure) **means a feeling of happiness or satisfaction.(आनंद)
